name: Anandha Krishnan
intro: I build reliable Linux systems, automate deployments, and turn cloud infrastructure into repeatable code.
about: Junior Server Administrator at HashRoot Technologies, supporting production Linux and web hosting environments. My work spans AWS infrastructure, containers, CI/CD, server troubleshooting, and security. I am pursuing a BCA at IGNOU and building my career in DevOps.

experience.summary: Administer production Linux servers and cPanel/WHM and CyberPanel hosting. Troubleshoot web, database, DNS, SSL/TLS and email incidents; monitor systems, verify backups, and assist with migrations and hardening.
Assisted with Linux administration, server monitoring, hosting operations, and customer issue investigation across web servers and databases.
Built hands-on Linux and AWS labs, provisioned infrastructure with Terraform, automated Django deployments with Ansible, and worked with GitLab CI, Docker and Docker Compose.

projects.name: Kisip OS
projects.description: A Debian-based desktop OS project with custom branding, GNOME defaults, build configuration, installer code, and recorded VM validation. Hardware validation remains in progress.

projects.name: Kisip Music
projects.description: A local-first music player with an Electron desktop shell, a Next.js backend, and server-side YouTube API configuration. Includes Linux packaging and launcher scripts.

projects.name: AWS High-Availability Infrastructure
projects.description: Built a multi-tier AWS lab with VPC subnets, EC2, load balancing, Auto Scaling and ACM. Project details are in my CV.

projects.name: Automated Application Deployment
projects.description: Hands-on Django deployments with Ansible, Nginx and Gunicorn, plus GitLab CI pipelines and Docker Compose. See my CV for details.
